paragraph: Today’s Granville composite registers at a cautious 44 out of 100 with no active breadth divergence warnings, pointing to an underlying market hesitation that demands tactical selectivity. Internal metrics show a split picture, highlighted by a bullish bellwether semi-performance surging 1.20% against the broader market, which is countered by weak transport relative strength down 0.95% and an 11.13% spike in the VIX. This volatility surge is further exacerbated by an elevated spot VIX of 25.46 alongside a backwardated term structure and a front-loaded fear skew that reflects persistent near-term hedging pressure. Meanwhile, macroeconomic conditions remain tense as high-yield credit spreads widen to 3.34% and small caps continue to lag large caps at 0.3673, though stabilizing real yields at 2.92% provide a minor anchor against broader macro crosscurrents. Expect a defensive, choppy session as the market digests elevated option-market fear and sector divergence, dictating a near-term defensive lean until the composite breaks back above neutral.
